player_prompt.intro:
O kile wa ba Player {player_id} mo Connect Four.
Seswantšho sa gago sa disiki: {symbol}.
Bodi ya mchezo e na {num_rows} mafelo le {num_cols} mekgolokgolo.
Bapalami ba tšea mekgolokgolo ya go tšea disiki tša bona mo e nngwe ya mekgolokgolo (0 go {end_col}).
Wa pele go kopanya (tša gagwe) disiki tše nne ka tlhogo, ka thoko, goba ka diagonal o a fenya.
Ka mekgolokgolo ya gago, kenya nomoro ya mekgolokgolo mo mabakeng a go dira kgato ya gago.
Ka mohlala: '[col 4]' goba '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Boto ya papadi ga e bonale go baphadiši.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Fomate ya kgato e fošagetše. Fomate e letetšwego: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Modiri {player_id}, Kitso e kgolegile. Koloni {col} e le ka ntle ga meraro.
invalid_move.already_full: Modiri {player_id}, Kitso e kgolegile. Koloni {col} e kgabagatse.

action.dropped_disk: Modiri {player_id} o a tsoma diski tša gagwe ({player_symbol}) mo kolonineng {col}.

outcome.win: Sebapadi {player_id} se thopa sefoka ka go kopanya tše nne!
outcome.draw: Papadi e ile ya felela ka go se kwane.
